detail.longDescription: We're launching Maintainers Coffee to make mailing a small thanks to someone with appreciated work more simple. Connect a GitHub account and add shipping details to receive orders at a unique link as: https://maintainers.coffee/github/theorderingmachine Someone can send coffee for USD $8 to either Canada or the US. Check out how this appears alongside GitHub Sponsors: https://github.com/maintainersdotcoffee/FUNDING.yml Feedback on sending and receiving flows and personal comfort creating and sharing a link is so welcomed!
